gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
